title: Indemnification run request 1.0 (spec020 IND-T13)
description: The body of POST /v1/runs: a snapshot and options for the sweeps and stresses that accompany the main run. The main run always uses the snapshot's own path count.

sensitivity_paths.description: Paths per sweep point (the sweeps reuse the run's seed). Null skips the sensitivities.

stresses.description: Whether to run the five named stresses.

stress_profile_overrides.description: Close-out profile settings that apply to the stresses alone.
